project_type: Flutter mobile app with Supabase backend (Edge Functions in Deno/TypeScript, Postgres DB)
build_system: Flutter CLI (not available in sandbox) + GitHub Actions for APK builds. Edge Functions are plain Deno TypeScript files under supabase/functions/
test_framework: No formal test framework in the project. Verification is structural (Dart analysis via imports/syntax) and manual.
build_command: Not available - no Flutter CLI in sandbox. Use structural verification.
test_command: Not available - no Flutter CLI in sandbox. Use Deno check for Edge Functions: deno check supabase/functions/generate-health-report/index.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Verify Edge Function TypeScript compiles: deno check --import-map=... 2. Verify Dart files have valid imports and no obvious syntax errors by reading them. 3. Confirm all referenced imports exist.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - workspace already has the repo cloned on feat/ai-health-coach branch.
environment_constraints: No Flutter CLI available in sandbox - cannot run flutter analyze or flutter test. Use structural/AST verification only. Deno is available for checking TypeScript Edge Functions. OPEN_INTERNET network mode.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Use existing AppColors, SoftCard, PillButton, SegmentedToggle widgets. No new pub dependencies allowed. Charts must use CustomPaint. Edge Functions use the _shared/common.ts invoke() pattern.
key_patterns: Edge Functions: Deno.serve with invoke() wrapper from common.ts, requireUser() for auth, adminClient for service-role queries. Flutter: Provider for state, DatabaseService for Supabase queries, models use fromMap/toMap pattern. Widgets: SoftCard for containers, AppSpacing.page for padding, SegmentedToggle for tab-like controls.
directory_structure: lib/screens/<feature>/ - screen files, lib/services/ - data services, lib/providers/ - state management, lib/models/ - data models, lib/widgets/ - reusable widgets, lib/utils/ - theme/constants, supabase/functions/<name>/index.ts - Edge Functions, supabase/functions/_shared/ - shared utilities
